items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: So we got that Young Men From New Orleans together, Monette Moore, the vocalist, Johnny St. Cyr, Harvey Brooks, Mike DeLeigh(?) and Alton Redd on drums.

ctx.x: This was probably June...or no, in May, because the season would open the first of June. So we got that Young Men From New Orleans together, Monette Moore, the vocalist, Johnny St. Cyr, Harvey Brooks, Mike DeLeigh(?) and Alton Redd on drums. That was your Young Men From New Orleans.
